visual_enhancers: 1px solid cyan or neutral borders for active states to emphasize Swiss design.
Use monochromatic contrast and sharp edges.

video_banner.desktop: Horizontal flex layout, h-[600px]. Active card gets flex-[4] or larger, inactive get flex-1.
video_banner.mobile: Vertical flex layout, min-h-[600px] or fixed heights. Active gets flex-[4], inactive flex-1.

motion.cards: Use framer-motion layout transitions. spring stiffness 300, damping 30 for snappy, technical feel.
motion.auto_advance: setInterval every 5 seconds, clear on hover or focus.

accessibility: Add 'data-testid' to all cards and play buttons.

VideoBanner.description: An auto-advancing, accordion-style carousel of video cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'framer-motion' if not present (e.g. `npm install framer-motion` or `yarn add framer-motion`).
Implement the VideoBanner in /app/frontend/src/components/VideoBanner.jsx and embed it into the Home page.
Use framer-motion `<motion.div layout>` for the cards to smoothly animate width changes between active and inactive states.
For the active card, render the thumbnail image with object-cover, overlaid with bg-black/60 so the white title text is readable.
For inactive cards, render a dark background (#111) with the category text rotated vertically (`writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg)`).
On active card click, reveal a responsive `iframe` overlay (or replace the card content inline) using the privacy-enhanced YouTube URL (`https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${id}?autoplay=1`).
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are added to each card and play button.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not use generic drop shadows; prefer 1px borders and distinct monochromatic layers.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions like 'transition-colors' or 'transition-opacity'.
DO NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Ensure high contrast and accessibility. Use standard HTML data-testid attributes for interactable elements (e.g., data-testid='video-card-0').
Do not use completely transparent backgrounds where text readability is an issue. Overlays must have a solid or semi-solid backdrop.
Stick strictly to the requested font families (Space Grotesk, IBM Plex) and the base color (#050505) with cyan accents.
